description: This Java source file defines the `Shutdown` command class, which represents a command for shutting down parts of a system. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and handling command payloads. The class is annotated as immutable and includes JSON serialization/deserialization logic, along with associated fields.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: Represents a 'shutdown' command with a specific reason for shutting down parts of the system. It is immutable and serializable/deserializable to/from JSON. Contains methods for creating, equality checks, and modifying headers.
